completion_promises.criterion_text: Full happy path returns transcript + tutor_response + one audio ref; transcript persisted via the standard turn path (two rows, verifiable through `SessionService`)
completion_promises.evidence: Implemented VoiceTurnService.voice_turn() which: (1) parses/validates upload via parse_voice_upload, (2) transcribes audio via AudioClient.transcribe, (3) calls SessionService.turn() with transcript as user_message passing reply_fn, (4) synthesizes response via AudioClient.synthesize, (5) stores in ChunkStore and returns VoiceTurnResult with transcript, tutor_response, and one AudioRef. Test test_happy_path_returns_voice_turn_result verifies all components and that SessionService.turn was called (which persists two rows per its contract).

completion_promises.criterion_text: Validation/UnintelligibleQuery/STT-down paths add **no** turn; TTS-down-after-turn returns text-only result with the turn recorded exactly once (ASSUM-005)
completion_promises.evidence: Implemented three failure paths: (1) Validation errors from parse_voice_upload propagate immediately before any STT call (test_rejection_precedes_stt verifies STT call count = 0 on RecordingTooLarge). (2) Empty/whitespace transcript raises UnintelligibleQuery before turn is recorded (test_unintelligible_query_when_transcript_empty verifies SessionService.turn not called). (3) STT VoiceUnavailable propagates before turn (test_stt_unavailable_propagates_before_turn verifies no turn). (4) ASSUM-005: TTS failure after turn is committed returns text-only result with audio=[] (test_assum_005_tts_failure_after_turn_returns_text_only verifies turn was recorded once and result has empty audio list).

completion_promises.criterion_text: ChunkStore: TTL expiry → `get` returns None; cap eviction oldest-first; wrong session → None; chunk_ids unguessable and collision-free across rapid turns
completion_promises.evidence: Implemented ChunkStore with: (1) TTL expiry checked on get and put (_evict_expired method) - test_ttl_expiry_on_get and test_ttl_eviction_on_put verify TTL behavior. (2) Hard cap with oldest-first eviction (_evict_oldest method) - test_hard_cap_eviction_oldest_first verifies oldest entry evicted when max_entries exceeded. (3) Session-scoped keys (session_id, chunk_id) tuple - test_get_returns_none_for_wrong_session verifies cross-session isolation. (4) Unguessable IDs via secrets.token_urlsafe(16) - test_put_returns_unguessable_chunk_id verifies IDs are unique and non-trivial (>8 chars).

completion_promises.criterion_text: No audio bytes at rest: no disk/DB writes of audio anywhere in the module; no audio bytes in log records (test with a capturing log handler)
completion_promises.evidence: ChunkStore uses in-memory dict only (self._store), never writes to disk or DB. VoiceTurnService discards audio bytes immediately after transcription (comment in code: 'Discard audio bytes immediately (ephemeral invariant)'). All logging uses chunk_id only, never audio bytes. test_no_audio_bytes_in_logs uses caplog fixture to verify no audio bytes (b'fake audio wav bytes' or b'wav audio bytes') appear in any log messages.
